sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Scavenger is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text:
"Listen brother, I've got a job for you. You know I'm pretty much the only guy who deals in all kinds of nylon. Well, I was. Lately, some competition has started popping up... I can't afford to lose my edge. And wouldn't you know it, one of my shipments is fucking delayed!

Can you go around Tarkov and bring me some stuff to sell? I really need this, brother! Don't worry, I'll pay you for the goods. Here's the list of what I need."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Must be level 29 to start this quest.

sections.heading: Objectives
sections.text:
- Hand over any Found in Raid items from the Facecovers category x15
- Hand over any Found in Raid items from the Headgear category x15
- Hand over any Found in Raid items from the Headests category x15
- Hand over any Found in Raid items from the Eyewear category category x15
- Hand over any Found in Raid items from the Body Armor category category x15
